title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
abstract: Safety critical systems involve the tight coupling between potentially conflicting control objectives and safety constraints. This paper develops a methodology that unifies safety conditions expressed as control barrier functions with performance objectives expressed as control Lyapunov functions in real-time optimization-based controllers. The resulting quadratic programs mediate safety and performance, and are demonstrated on adaptive cruise control and lane keeping problems.

title: Safe Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Stability Guarantees
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30
abstract: Reinforcement learning is powerful for learning policies from experimental data, but unconstrained exploration may be harmful on real systems. The paper combines control-theoretic Lyapunov stability verification with statistical dynamics models to learn high-performance policies with stability certificates, while safely collecting data and expanding the certified safe region.

title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor
abstract: Soft actor-critic is an off-policy actor-critic deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on the maximum entropy framework. The actor maximizes expected reward and entropy, while off-policy updates and a stable stochastic actor-critic formulation improve sample efficiency and robustness across continuous-control benchmark tasks.
